assets.target_pose: 弹力带肩外旋起点：本人右肘屈约90°贴身，右手握带位于舒适腹前起点；锚点在本人左侧。
assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, step 155 T-AXU-023 s01.
Input reference images 1–3 define the SAME adult East Asian woman, tied-back dark ponytail, plain white short-sleeved T-shirt, dark charcoal slim athletic trousers, white trainers, and softly lit seamless cool gray-blue studio. Reference 4 defines the resistance-band equipment and the correct anatomical RIGHT action arm; do not copy its end-position pose.
Create one new independent portrait photograph showing the START position for RIGHT SHOULDER EXTERNAL ROTATION with a light resistance band. She stands comfortably with feet hip-width, chest and pelvis facing straight forward, relaxed neck, no shrug. Her own RIGHT arm is on the viewer's LEFT, and her left arm hangs relaxed on viewer's RIGHT. The right upper arm hangs vertically tucked against her right ribs, right elbow at approximately 90 degrees remains immediately beside her right waist. A thin rolled gray towel between right upper arm and ribs stays visible. The right forearm is horizontal at elbow height, gently rotated inward across the front of the abdomen; right fist holding one black D-handle is in front of the navel, comfortable abdomen-front start position, NOT out to the side. Wrist perfectly neutral and aligned with the forearm, thumb uppermost, natural five-finger grip.
A single gray resistance band connects the right-hand handle to a clearly visible secure clamp on a dark metal post positioned on HER LEFT side, at viewer's RIGHT edge, at elbow height. Post has a heavy stable base. The band runs freely across IN FRONT of the abdomen with a visible air gap, never through her body, never behind her waist, taut lightly and logically attached to the handle and clamp. Keep her left arm out of the band path.
Camera is a slightly elevated oblique-front viewpoint, approximately 15 degrees looking down and 10 degrees from her right side, so the right elbow angle, horizontal forearm, abdomen, band path and anchor are plainly visible. Composition includes head, torso, both feet, hand and the full fixed post with base. Wide enough portrait framing, realistic anatomy, studio teaching-photo clarity, uncluttered soft shadows, no text, no labels, no arrows, no logo, no watermark, no duplicate figure, no montage. Show exactly ONE posture. Do not extend the action elbow, do not abduct shoulder, do not rotate torso.

assets.target_pose: 右肘原位贴身，右前臂向本人右外侧转，右手远离腹前；锚点与带设置延续s01。
assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, step 155 T-AXU-023 s02. The FIRST image is the already approved START photograph and the exact composition, camera, woman, clothes, light, anatomy, feet, towel, anchor post and band apparatus to preserve. The other three are identity references for the same woman. Make a single new standalone photograph for the END pose of RIGHT SHOULDER EXTERNAL ROTATION, keeping all scene and body invariants from the first reference.
Change ONLY the right shoulder rotation: her anatomical right arm is on the viewer's LEFT. Keep the right upper arm vertical against her right ribs, the rolled gray towel in place, and the right elbow at the exact same near-waist point, bent about 90 degrees. Rotate the right forearm OUTWARD, away from the abdomen and toward her own right side (toward viewer's LEFT), so the right black D-handle and fist are now well LEFT of the elbow in the image rather than in front of her abdomen. The forearm remains approximately horizontal at elbow height; natural comfortable external rotation, clearly distinct from the abdomen-front pose in reference 1. Keep the elbow beside the torso, NOT out to the side, and never draw a side-raise or elbow-extension exercise. The right wrist is straight in line with her forearm, thumb uppermost, natural grasp with normal fingers.
Her left arm remains down naturally on viewer's RIGHT, chest, head and hips orientation exactly unchanged, shoulders relaxed, no torso twist or lean. Both feet still planted in same locations.
Keep the heavy fixed metal anchor post in exactly the same viewer-right position, HER LEFT side. The gray resistance band connects securely from its elbow-height clamp to the right-hand black handle, follows an unobstructed continuous path across the FRONT of her abdomen, visibly separated from body, with natural light tension; never pass it through the torso or behind her. Band length and stretch reflect the moved hand, apparatus design unchanged.
Exact same portrait framing and elevated oblique-front teaching-photo camera as reference 1, full body and post base in frame, realistic facial identity and normal limb proportions, plain white T-shirt, charcoal pants, white shoes, cool gray-blue seamless studio, soft lighting. Exactly one person in one posture, no text, no arrows, no labels, no collage, no motion blur, no watermarks.

Image 2 is ONLY a pose reference for the right forearm pointing toward viewer LEFT. Do not copy or mirror its post.

The right fist must be fully outside the silhouette of her abdomen, to the LEFT of the tucked elbow, at approximately the same height as elbow. In image 1 the right elbow is near horizontal coordinate 580 of the 1122-width picture; preserve that elbow point, but move the right fist from near x690 to near x440, exactly the outside starting pose. Keep the left-side post and its heavy floor base fixed exactly as image 1. The band now connects directly from that left post clamp to the moved black handle in the open gap; one short taut gray band, naturally attached on the handle's viewer-left side. No band across the torso and no band on viewer right.
Every other part of image 1 remains unchanged: facial identity, head and chest direction, upper arm and elbow, left arm hanging, stance, feet, towel, clothing, lighting, composition and camera. Full portrait photo, exactly one person and one posture, no text, no arrows, no watermark. assets.target_pose: 内旋終点：右肘原位靠身，右前臂内转使右手位于腹前，胸口和锚点方向不变。
assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE standalone photorealistic rehabilitation teaching photograph, step 156 T-AXU-024 s01, RIGHT SHOULDER INTERNAL ROTATION start position.
Reference images 1–3 identify the SAME adult East Asian woman with dark tied-back ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt and charcoal trousers, soft seamless gray-blue studio. Reference 4 establishes her full-body stance, white trainers, neutral right wrist grip, rolled gray towel and right-arm comfortable OUTSIDE start pose; use that woman and pose, BUT the secure anchor MUST be on the opposite side of the scene for this new exercise.
She stands upright, feet hip width flat on floor, chest and pelvis facing forward, relaxed shoulders. Her anatomical RIGHT arm is on viewer's LEFT. Right upper arm is vertical and pressed gently alongside her right ribs, gray rolled towel between the upper arm and ribs; right elbow bent about 90 degrees beside her right waist, not displaced outward. Right forearm approximately horizontal at elbow height, rotated to a comfortable outward position: right fist and black D-handle to HER RIGHT (toward viewer's LEFT of elbow), well outside the abdomen. Straight natural wrist aligned with forearm, thumb uppermost, normal fingers wrapped around the handle. Her left arm simply rests down on viewer's RIGHT. No shoulder abduction, elbow straightening, torso rotation or leaning.
CRITICAL equipment setting: one fixed dark metal anchor post is on HER RIGHT side, at VIEWER'S LEFT edge, with heavy stable floor base. It is approximately 60 cm lateral to her right hand, a clear gap. Secure gray resistance band firmly attaches to a visible clamp on this post at the same elbow/hand height. The band goes directly from VIEWER-LEFT post across the open space to her right black handle, a short horizontal taut path completely on the RIGHT anatomical side, without crossing the torso. There is NO post at viewer's right and NO band extending toward viewer's right. The band never enters, wraps around, or passes behind the body.
Slightly elevated oblique-front camera, 15-degree downward view, about 10 degrees from her right side, clear right elbow, forearm, wrist, chest and complete anchor. Broad portrait frame head to feet and full post base, subject slightly right of centre so left-side post is visible. Soft accurate studio light, realistic skin and clothing texture, good photographic anatomy and proportional limbs, a single person, one single static posture. Absolutely no text, no arrows, no labels, no watermark, no collage.
